title: Terminal appearance is fully hardcoded — ignores the app's code font setting, no zoom, fixed scrollback
existing_state: The terminal always renders Courier New 10pt in #BBBBBB-on-black (Forms/InteractiveTerminalForm.cs:117-119; both theme branches at 154-165 set the identical colors). The app already has FontSettings.CodeFontFamily (default "Cascadia Code", Models/AppConfiguration.cs:227) used by the rest of the UI, but the terminal ignores it. There is no font-size control and no Ctrl+wheel/Ctrl+= zoom, even though the viewport already invalidates cell metrics on FontChanged (UI/InteractiveTerminalViewportControl.cs:76-80), so live resizing would just work. Scrollback is hardcoded at 10,000 lines (Services/SshTerminalOptionsFactory.cs:15 DefaultHistoryMaxLength) with no setting; SettingsDialog.cs contains zero terminal/scrollback options (grep: 0 hits). Window position is remembered only in a per-process static (form 50-51, 739-771), unlike every other window which persists to WindowState.
recommendation: Use config.FontSettings.CodeFontFamily (+ a new TerminalFontSize) when constructing the viewport font in InteractiveTerminalForm's ctor (line 117), and add Ctrl+MouseWheel zoom in TerminalView_MouseWheel (form 366-377) that rescales the Font (the FontChanged hook recomputes cells and EmitTerminalSizeChanged renegotiates cols/rows automatically). Surface scrollback length as a setting feeding SshTerminalOptionsFactory.CreateScriptingWithHistory's historyMaxLength parameter, and persist terminal window bounds to WindowState alongside the other windows.
user_benefit: Daily-driver legibility: users get their preferred monospace font and can zoom during demos or on high-DPI monitors, and long device outputs (show tech-support easily exceeds 10k lines) stop silently scrolling out of reach.

evidence.note: Courier New 10pt and fixed colors hardcoded; both theme branches identical
CodeFontFamily setting exists app-wide but the terminal never reads it
DefaultHistoryMaxLength = 10000, not configurable; SettingsDialog has no terminal options
FontChanged already invalidates cell metrics — zoom support is nearly free

mockup_idea: Settings dialog 'Terminal' section: Font family dropdown (inherits Code font), Size spinner, Scrollback lines field; beside it a terminal screenshot at Cascadia Code 12pt vs the current Courier New 10pt.
